timezone.description: 解释 create 自然时间并显示提醒的 IANA 时区；ISO 绝对时间仍须显式 offset

en.title: Timezone
en.description: IANA timezone for natural reminder times and display. Absolute ISO times still require an explicit offset.

maxTasks.description: 每实例聊天个人提醒池的活跃任务上限；与管理员池独立，降低上限不删除既有任务

en.title: Max chat reminders
en.description: Maximum active personal chat reminders per instance, separate from administrator tasks. Lowering the limit does not delete existing tasks.

adminMaxTasks.description: 每实例管理员提醒池的活跃任务上限（待执行、暂停或未确认）；与聊天池独立，两池总量可达上限之和

en.title: Max admin reminders
en.description: Maximum active administrator reminders (scheduled, paused or unconfirmed) per instance. Separate from chat tasks; the two quotas are additive.

maxTasksPerSender.description: 同一发送者在同一会话的任务上限

en.title: Max reminders per sender
en.description: Maximum tasks per sender in the same conversation.

batchSize.description: 每次扫描最多投递的任务数

en.title: Batch size
en.description: Maximum tasks delivered in each scan.

missedGraceSeconds.description: 周期轮次超过此延迟后跳过；停机期间不补历史轮次

en.title: Missed-run grace (seconds)
en.description: Skip recurring runs delayed beyond this many seconds. Missed runs during downtime are not backfilled.
